answer: Operator Liability Registry. An agent's first action registers a real legal or billing identity with the platform, and every wallet that identity spawns is linked to it. If any linked wallet is confirmed as a sybil, the registry suspends the operator's entire fleet and forfeits a fixed per-wallet cleanup charge. An attacker cannot island each fake wallet as disposable, because the cost lands on the one identity they cannot abandon. Like an atlas binding many maps to one owner, the ledger ties every account back to that operator, and a single gale of enforcement wipes the whole fleet.
